text: The CLI prints the raw error message instead of going through errorLine, so a message that echoes the API key would print the key.
excerpt: The one way any Jev tool turns an error into its one-line reason: the first line of the message, with the key from `env` redacted in case a message ever echoes it. Every tool and CLI uses this, never its own copy.

text: The flag threshold is hard-coded in the verifier instead of living in the constants file.
quote: return { decision: answer.noul < VERIFY_FLAG_BELOW ? 'flag' : 'keep', noul: answer.noul, reason: 'checked' };
excerpt: Every tunable number the Jev tools use, and the model they use it with, in one reviewed place.

text: The new crash reporter sends stack traces to a third-party service on every launch.
excerpt: No telemetry, analytics, ads, or monetisation of any kind, including build-flagged.
